newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Congo's Kabila begins state visit to Namibia.
newsitem.headline: Congo's Kabila begins state visit to Namibia.

text.p: Laurent Kabila, president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, formerly Zaire, arrived in Windhoek on Monday for a two-day state visit to Namibia.
Kabila will hold private and official talks with President Sam Nujoma. Officials in Windhoek have said the possibility of Namibia drawing water from the Congo River is expected to top the agenda.
Kabila's rebel alliance ousted former Zaire president Mobutu Sese Seko in May. Kabila renamed the country shortly after taking power.
